name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc42): on a slow site, a customization call (import, export, publish, the published list) that timed out could leave its sign-in open with nothing able to close it, so its API seat stayed taken until the site timed it out. Two such calls filled a two-seat site while release_sessions reported nothing to release. The plugin now keeps such a session and goes on signing it out: by itself in the background, on release_sessions, and when the next sign-in is refused because the seats are full. The error for a site that did not answer is no longer blank: it reads 'no answer within 120 s (ReadTimeout)' and says when a seat may be left taken, so wait for the site before trying again. Not fixed: a sign-in the site completes without its answer arriving cannot be signed out, and the error says when that may have happened. rc41's fix stands: an edit to an existing grid row on a Classic-UI screen is saved. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
